'''Jocoro Desilijic Tiure''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who became a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] by some [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] that followed the Battle of Endor, Jocoro ran a small criminal empire from a base on<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Du Hutta]].<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref> After 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY's]] [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], where another Hutt crime lord, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="NEC" /> one of Jabba's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Umpass-stay/Legends|Umpass-stay]], went on to work for Jocoro on Du Hutta.<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jocoro was introduced in [[1997]]'s ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SETSB">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> The Hutt was first named as "Jocoro" in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article [[Rich Handley]] wrote for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Who's Who" /> which was published on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' would later identify the Hutt by the full name of Jocoro Desilijic Tiure.<ref name="CSWE" />
